DistanceGame.title: How many kilometres?
DistanceGame.intro: Two cities, one question: how many kilometres apart are they? Guess with the slider and collect points over {rounds} rounds.
DistanceGame.howScale: The slider is logarithmic: fine steps for short distances, wide steps for long ones. Fine-tune with the arrow keys or the − and + buttons.
DistanceGame.howScore: Within 2% of the real distance earns the full 1,000 points; the further off you are, the faster the score drops.
DistanceGame.offline: No internet needed: the game runs entirely on your device.

MapGame.title: Find it on the map
MapGame.intro: You get a city name; you find it on the globe. Spin, zoom and tap to drop your pin, and collect points over {rounds} rounds.
MapGame.howGesture: Drag to spin the globe, pinch to zoom. Tap to drop a pin and move it as often as you like. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and + / −.
MapGame.howScore: Land within 50 km of the real spot for the full 1,000 points; the further away, the smoother the score falls.
MapGame.howHint: Stuck? Take a hint: a ring shows the rough area, but that round’s score is halved.
MapGame.offline: No internet needed: the game runs entirely on your device.
MapGame.keyboardHelp: Globe: arrow keys spin, plus and minus zoom, Enter or Space marks the centre of the screen.

Consent.title: Your cookie choices
Consent.body: We always use the storage needed to run the site. With your permission, we use Google Analytics to measure how the site is used and let Google personalise ads to your interests. You can change your choice at any time via the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page.
Consent.dialogIntro: Choose which technologies you allow. Necessary ones are required for the site to work and can't be switched off. For details, see the
Consent.necessaryBody: Delivering pages securely; remembering your cookie choice, the departure city in the flight animation and your flag game progress on your device; caching the pages you visit so you can read them offline. None of this is used to track you on other sites.
Consent.analyticsBody: Measuring which pages are read and how the site is used with Google Analytics. If you allow it, Google Analytics cookies (_ga) are used; if you don't, Google Analytics isn't loaded at all.
Consent.adsBody: Cookies and identifiers that let Google AdSense personalise and measure ads based on your interests. If you decline, you may see non-personalised or limited ads.
Consent.saved: Your cookie choices have been saved.
